name: tlv-parser
description: Zero-dependency recursive TLV (Tag-Length-Value) parser, written in TypeScript and compiled to pure ES modules. Supports raw TLVNode[] or nested object keyed by tag.

scripts.build: bun run build:js && bun run build:types
scripts.build:js: bun build src/index.ts src/domain/TLVNode.ts src/interfaces/IParser.ts src/usecases/TLVParser.ts src/usecases/TLVObjectifier.ts src/adapters/TLVParserAdapter.ts --target=node --outdir dist --format=esm --no-bundle

author: Kawin Viriyaprasopsook <kawin.v@kkumail.com>
